entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I'm calling about a jersey I recently ordered. I need to start a return or an exchange.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Of course. The name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF8675309.
Thank you, Alex. I see the order right here. So, regarding the jersey, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference matter?
It's a preference thing. I think I just ordered the wrong size. It's a bit too tight in the shoulders for me.

Understood. Getting the right fit is crucial for comfort on a ride. Let me just check the policy for you. I see the item was delivered 20 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return window for standard items.
Great. So I can send it back for a different size?

Absolutely. We can definitely process an exchange for you. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just pack the jersey back in its original packaging, attach the label, and drop it at any post office.

Okay, that's straightforward enough. Now, since I have to go through the hassle of repackaging and shipping this back, is there any chance you could add a small credit to my account or a 10% discount code for my trouble?

I understand the request, Alex. While our policy doesn't allow for discount codes on sizing exchanges, I do see that you're one of our VIP members. What I can do for you is upgrade the shipping on your replacement jersey to complimentary two-day express, so you get the right size much faster. Would that work for you?
Express shipping on the exchange? Yes, that would be great, actually. That saves me some time. I appreciate you doing that.

It's my pleasure. I've put the note on your account. As soon as we receive the return scan from the post office, your new size will be sent out via express. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome, Alex. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
